verdict.rationale: Base44 is a hosted AI app builder, so whether its own source is available under an open license is a fair question to ask. The evidence only shows that users can export or sync their own app's code (CLI eject, GitHub sync). It never says the Base44 platform's source is published, and no open license is mentioned anywhere. Exporting your own generated app code is an adjacent feature and does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
